record.original_question: For the complex Monge-Ampere flow in a bounded smooth strictly pseudoconvex domain, Do proved existence and smoothing when the initial datum u_0 is bounded and plurisubharmonic on a neighborhood of the domain. Determine whether the flow can be started from an arbitrary plurisubharmonic initial function, not necessarily bounded.

evidence.quote: These flows can thus be run from a bounded plurisubharmonic initial data. The following question is natural, in view of the corresponding global results from [GZ13, DiNL14b]: Question 44 (Guedj). Can one run the above complex Monge-Ampere flow from an arbitrary plurisubharmonic function ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \Subset \mathbb{C}^n$ be a bounded smooth strictly pseudoconvex domain, and let $\varphi \in C^\infty(\partial\Omega \times [0,\infty))$ be a smooth boundary datum. Consider the complex Monge–Ampère parabolic Cauchy–Dirichlet problem
\[
\begin{cases}
(dd^c u_t)^n = e^{\dot u_t + F(t,z,u_t)}\,\beta^n & \text{in } \Omega \times (0,\infty),\\
u_t = \varphi(\cdot,t) & \text{on } \partial\Omega \times [0,\infty),\\
u_{|t=0} = u_0 & \text{in } \Omega,
\end{cases}
\]
where $\beta = dd^c |z|^2$ is the standard Kähler form on $\mathbb{C}^n$, $u_t(z) = u(t,z)$, $\dot u_t = \partial_t u$, and $F$ is smooth and non-decreasing in the last variable. It is known that for any initial datum $u_0$ that is plurisubharmonic and bounded in a neighborhood of $\overline{\Omega}$ (and matches $\varphi(\cdot,0)$ on $\partial\Omega$), there exists a unique solution $u$ that is smooth on $\Omega \times (0,\infty)$ and continuous up to $\{0\}\times\Omega$, exhibiting an instantaneous smoothing effect.

Question: Does this existence and smoothing theory extend to arbitrary plurisubharmonic initial data $u_0$ on $\Omega$ that are not assumed to be bounded? More precisely, can one construct a (pluripotential) solution to the above flow starting from any plurisubharmonic function $u_0$ on $\Omega$, and obtain instantaneous regularization of $u_t$ for $t>0$?
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Guedj–Lu–Zeriahi and follow-ups, including a 2025 paper on the pluripotential Cauchy–Dirichlet problem for the complex Monge–Ampère flow with general measures) develops weak/pluripotential parabolic theory in strictly pseudoconvex domains, but the existing existence and smoothing results still require the initial datum to be bounded plurisubharmonic. No source verifying that the flow can be started from an arbitrary (unbounded) plurisubharmonic function in this local setting was found, so the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The Pluripotential Cauchy-Dirichlet problem for the Complex Monge-Ampère flow with a general measure
status_evidence.snippet: Solvability is established under the condition that the boundary/initial datum at t=0 is bounded and plurisubharmonic in Ω; previous results are extended by removing strict positivity of the measure but boundedness of the initial datum is retained.
status_evidence.claim: Current parabolic pluripotential theory for the local complex Monge–Ampère flow still assumes bounded plurisubharmonic initial data.
